thesis: Bloom Energy Corporation manufactures and installs solid oxide fuel cell systems marketed as **Energy Servers** for on-site electric power. **[Fact]** Customers buy product blocks, pay for installation, and often sign long-term service or electricity contracts on the installed base. **[Fact]** FY2025 total revenue was **$2,024 million** (+37% versus FY2024): product **$1,531 million**, installation **$204 million**, service **$228 million**, and electricity **$60 million**. **[Fact]** The company also develops **Bloom Electrolyzers** for hydrogen production on the same platform. **[Fact]** South Korea is the second-largest market with roughly **682 megawatts** deployed through SK ecoplant and SK eternix partnerships; the U.S. is the largest market by revenue. **[Fact]** Cash and equivalents were **$2,491 million** at March 31, 2026, against long-term recourse debt of roughly **$2,599 million**.
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** narrative premium (AI datacenter power scarcity priced ahead of durable per-share owner cash).
